details:
Q1. Which part of the repository should this issue target? If multiple areas are involved, answer with a combination like `A+C` and name them.
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan workflows
B. Implement / review_autofix / validate workflows
C. Orchestrate / orchestrate_poll / issue-lifecycle automation
D. Another specific workflow, script, or file path — name it (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug/regression — include current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change behavior — describe the exact new behavior (RECOMMENDED)
C. Reduce cost/noise/latency — name what is too noisy, slow, or expensive (RECOMMENDED)
D. Improve docs/operator clarity — point to what is missing or confusing (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What should planning use as the success signal?
Choices:
A. A failing run / issue / PR / log prefix to anchor the work (RECOMMENDED)
B. The exact workflow(s), script(s), or file(s) you expect to change (RECOMMENDED)
C. 1-3 acceptance criteria for what “better” means (RECOMMENDED)
D. No artifact is available; use only my description
